content: Sɑkɑri u nɔni seeyɑ mɑ u mɑɑ kɔbi nnɛ wɑ.
Mɑ u ɡɔrɑdo wi u kɑ nùn ɡɑri mɔ̀ bikiɑ u nɛɛ, kɔbi yirɑ̀ mini. Mɑ u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, kɔbi yi yi Yudɑbɑ kɑ Isirelibɑ kɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɡibu yɑrinɑsiɑwɑ mi.
Yen biru, Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑɑ nùn sekobu nnɛ sɔ̃ɔsi.

Mɑ u nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑ seko be, bɑ kobu nɑ. Mɑ u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, bɑ nɑwɑ bu kɑ kɔbi yi tɔ̃yɑ ko, kpɑ bu yi bɔɔku yi, yi yi Yudɑn tem wɔri yi mɛn tɔmbu yɑrinɑsiɑ sere ben ɡoo kun kpĩɑ u kɑ tii yinɑ.
Sɑkɑri u wɛ̃ɛ wɑ kɑ̃siru sɔɔ
Ye Sɑkɑri u mɑɑ mɛɛrɑ, yerɑ u durɔ ɡoo wɑ u wɛ̃ɛ yĩirutii nɛni.
Mɑ u nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mɑnɑ ɑ dɔɔ. Mɑ u wisɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ dɔɔwɑ n Yerusɑlɛmu yĩire n kɑ yen dɛ̃ɛbu kɑ yen yɑsum wɑ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdo wi u kɑ nùn ɡɑri mɔ̀, u susim wee, yerɑ ɡɔrɑdo ɡoo u mɑɑ nɑ u kɑ wiɔnɔ yinnɑ.
Mɑ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ dukɑ doo ɑ ɑluwɑɑsi wi sɔ̃ ɑ nɛɛ, Yerusɑlɛmu yɑ koo ko wuu ɡè bɑ ǹ mɑɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑru toosimɔ. Domi ɡen tɔmbu kɑ ɡen yɑɑ sɑbenu koo dɑbiɑ.
Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑɑ nɛɛ, u ko n sɑ̃ɑ nɡe ɡbɑ̃rɑ dɔ̃ɔɡiru Yerusɑlɛmu yen sɔ̃. Mɛyɑ u ko n mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ yen bɛɛrɛ.
Yinni Gusunɔ u be bɑ rɑɑ

content.text: Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡeruɑ u nɛɛ,
bɛɛ be u rɑɑ yɑrinɑsiɑ hɑnduniɑn ɡoonu nnɛ ye sɔɔ,
i wurɑmɑ.
I seemɑ i wurɑmɑ sɑɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑn di.
Bɛɛ Yerusɑlɛmuɡibu, bɛɛ be i yoru dimɔ Bɑbiloniɔ,
i kisirɑmɑ.

content: Domi wi, Gusunɔ wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni u nɛɛ,

content.text: yenibɑn biru,
Yerusɑlɛmun bɛɛrɛ yɑ koo wurɑmɑ.
Wee u mɑn ɡɔriɔ bwese ni nu bɛɛn yɑ̃nu ɡurɑn mi.
U nɛɛ, nù n mɑɑ bɛɛ bɑbɑ,
yɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe win tiin nɔniyɑ nu bɑbɑ.
Wee u koo nu nɔmɑ doke
kpɑ nu ɡɔsiɑ bɛɛn yobu.

content: Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ nu koo ɡiɑ mɑ Gusunɔ, wɔllu kɑ tem Yinniwɑ u mɑn ɡɔrimɑ.

content.text: Wiyɑ u nɛɛ, bɛɛ Yerusɑlɛmuɡibu, i nuku dobun kuuki koowo.
Domi u koo nɑ u n kɑ bɛɛ wɑ̃ɑ.
Bwese dɑbinɑ nu koo wurɑ wi, Yinni Gusunɔn mi ɡiɑ yen tɔ̃ɔ te,
kpɑ nu ko win tɔmbu,
kpɑ u n wɑ̃ɑ kɑ be.

content: Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ i ko i ɡiɑ mɑ wi, Gusunɔ wɔllu kɑ tem Yinniwɑ u mɑn ɡɔrimɑ.

content.text: U ko n mɑɑ Yudɑ mɔ tem dɛɛrɑm mɛ sɔɔ.
U koo mɑɑ Yerusɑlɛmu ɡɔsi.
Bɑɑwure u koo nɔɔ mɑri Yinni Gusunɔn wuswɑɑɔ.
Domi u koo seemɑ win wɑ̃ɑ yee dɛɛrɑrun di.
